casual1.custom: My free-scene design: a quiet solo late breakfast at a sunlit railway-station noodle counter, daytime indoors with bright even light. After tiring practice, she has discovered that her enormous steamed bun is too hot to bite, a faint wistful smile with raised inner brows. Seated sideways on a high stool, torso gently facing the viewer, she holds the bun on a small paper napkin in her right hand at chest height, right upper arm dropping from its own shoulder and elbow bent forward; her left arm drops naturally with her left palm flat on the counter. Three-quarter seated portrait from head to knees, eye-level camera, face clearly visible. Her original outfit, not in our catalog, is a saffron-yellow towel-knit strapless culotte romper: a fitted fully opaque chest band and a curved waist bridge join to broad cropped trouser legs, an oval midriff aperture and bare shoulders, secure coverage of chest and pelvis. Her pale-purple training bag with two white bands rests on the adjacent empty counter ledge; no other people, no readable signs. This is a pause over breakfast, not a workshop or equipment task.

why.custom: 장면 자유 지정 컷: 훈련생의 식욕과 잠깐의 휴식을 역 식당의 뜨거운 찐빵 순간으로, 다른 계획과 다른 장소·행동·옷을 설계한다.

casual6.custom: My free category-and-situation design: an adult event costume for a solo ribbon-dance intermission inside a small community dance hall in warm lamplight, other parts of the room in shadow. She has just finished her first successful balance sequence and now makes a relieved standing overhead stretch: both upper arms clearly rise from their own shoulders, elbows gently bent outward, open hands separated above her head, five natural fingers on each. Her feet are both planted, weight on one leg; front three-quarter full-body composition at chest-level camera, her violet eyes and face visible, heavy-lidded calm expression and relaxed parted lips as specified. Costume category: adult role-play/event fashion. Outfit not in our catalog: an opaque terracotta origami-fold performance bra-top whose broad folded lapels form a secure angular neckline, joined by a narrow side bridge to fitted teal dance culottes with scalloped side arches, bare waist and shoulders, fully covered chest and pelvis; soft dance slippers. The momentary situation is the overhead decompression stretch: her torso lengthens and the deliberately open side of the outfit reveals more of the side waist through that permanent shaped opening, without anything slipping, unfastening, blowing, becoming wet or transparent. A pale purple triangular hair bead and a white-banded lavender gym bag by the wall recall her source; no armor, no other people, no lettering.
